cards.front: I went to the doctor yesterday
cards.back: Fui al médico ayer
cards.example: Y me dijo que todo iba mejor.
cards.translation: ir → fui. Indefinido because it is a completed event in a closed past period.

cards.front: I was at home all day
cards.back: Estuve en casa todo el día
cards.translation: estar → estuve. Indefinido because the state is treated as a completed block of time.

cards.back: Tuve una reunión estresante

cards.front: I did a lot of work today
cards.back: Hice mucho trabajo hoy
cards.translation: hacer → hice. Irregular but only first person singular changes.

cards.back: No pude dormir anoche
cards.translation: poder → pude. Completed inability in a closed past period.

cards.back: Quise llamarte
cards.example: Pero al final se me hizo tarde.
cards.translation: querer → quise. In indefinido, often implies an attempted intention.

cards.front: The doctor told me to rest
cards.back: El médico me dijo que descansara
cards.translation: decir → dijo. Indirect recommendation triggers subjuntivo.

cards.front: I put the book on the table
cards.back: Puse el libro en la mesa
cards.example: Y luego me fui a dormir.

cards.back: Vine a casa tarde
cards.translation: venir → vine. Important movement verb in indefinido.

cards.back: Traje los documentos
cards.translation: traer → traje. Same irregular family as decir/dije.

cards.back: Lo supe

cards.translation: saber → supe. In indefinido often means 'I found out/knew suddenly'.

cards.back: Conocí a un tío interesante
cards.translation: conocer → conocí. In indefinido often means meeting someone for the first time.

cards.back: Conduje hasta Madrid
cards.translation: conducir → conduje. '-ducir' verbs follow the same irregular pattern.

cards.back: Me trajeron buenas noticias
cards.example: Y me quedé mucho más tranquilo.
cards.translation: traer → trajeron. Third person plural irregular.

cards.front: They told me the results were good
cards.back: Me dijeron que los resultados eran buenos
cards.translation: decir → dijeron. Notice the dropped 'i' in dijeron.

cards.front: I was able to finish the book
cards.back: Pude terminar el libro
Quise cambiar de trabajo
cards.translation: quiser in indefinido often sounds more decisive than quería.

cards.back: Tuve que explicar todo
cards.translation: tener que + infinitive = had to do something.

cards.front: I came because I was worried
cards.back: Vine porque estaba preocupado
cards.translation: Mix of indefinido event + imperfecto emotional background.

cards.front: I put on a new shirt
cards.back: Me puse una camisa nueva
cards.translation: ponerse → me puse. Very common reflexive irregular.

cards.back: Lo supe ayer
cards.translation: saber in indefinido often means discovering information.

cards.back: Dije lo mismo

cards.translation: traer → traje. Very useful professional chunk.

cards.translation: saber → supe often means discovering information suddenly.

cards.back: La conocí por el trabajo

cards.translation: traer → trajeron. Third person plural irregular.

cards.back: Se me olvidó responder

cards.back: Colloquial expression used to strongly but casually say 'no' or deny something.
